verses.text: The oracle concerning the wilderness of the sea. As windstorms in the Negev sweep on, It comes from the wilderness, from a terrifying land.
verses.textZh: 論海旁曠野的默示：有仇敵從曠野，從可怕之地而來，好像南方的旋風，猛然掃過。

verses.text: A harsh vision has been shown to me; The treacherous one [still] deals treacherously, and the destroyer [still] destroys. Go up, Elam, lay siege, Media; I have made an end of all the groaning she has caused.
verses.textZh: 令人悽慘的異象已默示於我。詭詐的行詭詐，毀滅的行毀滅。以攔哪，你要上去！瑪代啊，你要圍困！主說：我使一切歎息止住。

verses.text: For this reason my loins are full of anguish; Pains have seized me like the pains of a woman in labor. I am so bewildered I cannot hear, so terrified I cannot see.
verses.textZh: 所以，我滿腰疼痛；痛苦將我抓住，好像產難的婦人一樣。我疼痛甚至不能聽；我驚惶甚至不能看。

verses.text: My mind reels, horror overwhelms me; The twilight I longed for has been turned for me into trembling.
verses.textZh: 我心慌張，驚恐威嚇我。我所羨慕的黃昏，變為我的戰兢。

verses.text: They set the table, they spread out the cloth, they eat, they drink; 'Rise up, captains, oil the shields,'
verses.textZh: 他們擺設筵席，派人守望，又吃，又喝。首領啊，你們起來，用油抹盾牌。

verses.text: For thus the Lord says to me, 'Go, station the lookout, let him report what he sees.
verses.textZh: 主對我如此說：你去設立守望的，使他將所看見的述說。

verses.text: 'When he sees riders, horsemen in pairs, A train of donkeys, a train of camels, Let him pay close attention, very close attention.'
verses.textZh: 他看見軍隊，就是騎馬的一對一對地來，又看見驢隊，駱駝隊，就要側耳細聽。

verses.text: Then the lookout called, 'O Lord, I stand continually by day on the watchtower, And I am stationed every night at my guard post.
verses.textZh: 他像獅子吼叫，說：主啊，我白日常站在望樓上，整夜立在我守望所。

verses.text: 'Now behold, here comes a troop of riders, horsemen in pairs.' And one said, 'Fallen, fallen is Babylon; And all the images of her gods are shattered on the ground.'
verses.textZh: 看哪，有一隊軍兵騎著馬，一對一對地來。他就說：巴比倫傾倒了！傾倒了！他一切雕刻的神像都打碎於地。

verses.text: O my threshed [people], and my afflicted of the threshing floor! What I have heard from the LORD of hosts, The God of Israel, I make known to you.
verses.textZh: 我被打的禾稼，我場上的穀啊，我從萬軍之耶和華─以色列的神那裡所聽見的，都告訴你們了。

verses.text: The oracle concerning Edom. One keeps calling to me from Seir, 'Watchman, how far gone is the night? Watchman, how far gone is the night?'
verses.textZh: 論度瑪的默示：有人聲從西珥呼問我說：守望的啊，夜裡如何？守望的啊，夜裡如何？

verses.text: The watchman says, 'Morning comes but also night. If you would inquire, inquire; Come back again.'
verses.textZh: 守望的說：早晨將到，黑夜也來。你們若要問就可以問，可以回頭再來。

verses.text: The oracle about Arabia. In the thickets of Arabia you must spend the night, O caravans of Dedanites.
verses.textZh: 論亞拉伯的默示：底但結伴的客旅啊，你們必在亞拉伯的樹林中住宿。

verses.text: Bring water for the thirsty, O inhabitants of the land of Tema, Meet the fugitive with bread.
verses.textZh: 提瑪地的居民拿水來，送給口渴的，拿餅來迎接逃避的。

verses.text: For they have fled from the swords, From the drawn sword, and from the bent bow And from the press of battle.
verses.textZh: 因為他們逃避刀劍和出了鞘的刀，並上了弦的弓與刀兵的重災。

verses.text: For thus the Lord said to me, 'In a year, as a hired man would count it, all the splendor of Kedar will terminate;
verses.textZh: 主對我這樣說：一年之內，照雇工的年數，基達的一切榮耀必歸於無有。

verses.text: and the remainder of the number of bowmen, the mighty men of the sons of Kedar, will be few; for the LORD God of Israel has spoken.'
verses.textZh: 弓箭手所餘剩的，就是基達人的勇士，必然稀少，因為這是耶和華─以色列的神說的。
